operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The step computes a rank-correlation reward and applies reinforcement-learning policy optimization, neither of which is an input data transformation in the catalog.
The paper states clustering and differential-expression computations, which have no corresponding catalog operation.
These are similarity and retrieval-ranking evaluation metrics, not catalog data transformations.
